title: Optimized protocol for naive human pluripotent stem cell-derived trophoblast induction
protocol: Dilute 1.5 μg (3 μL) of Laminin-E8 in 1 mL/well of PBS and pipette the solution into one well of a newly prepared 6-well plate.
Incubate the laminin-coated wells at 37°C for at least 30 min.
Aspirate the medium from the wells containing naive PSCs and rinse with PBS two times.
Add 500 μL Accutase to the wells and incubate at 37°C for 10–15 min.
Add 1 mL of wash medium and gently pipette up and down to dislodge the naive PSCs from the well.
Transfer the cells to a 15-mL tube and add 5 mL of wash medium.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 1,300 rpm for 3 min.
Resuspend the pellet with 1 mL of t2iLGö medium containing Y-27632.
Collect the medium containing floating PSCs into a 15-mL tube.
Count the number of cells in the collected medium.
Centrifuge at 1,300 rpm for 3 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant after centrifugation.
Resuspend the cell pellet with 2 mL of nTE-1 medium.
Seed the resuspended cells onto Laminin-E8-coated dishes at a density of 2 × 10^4 to 4 × 10^4 cells/cm².
Change the medium to nTE-2 medium on the following day.
Change the medium again on the next day.
On day 3, obtain TACSTD2+ENPEP+ nTE with an efficiency of approximately 50–60%.
Optional: Induce nTE without using 10 ng/mL recombinant human BMP4 for the first 24 hours at a lower efficiency.
Prepare Laminin-E8-coated wells beforehand.
Add 1.5 μg (3 μL) of Laminin-E8 to 1 mL of PBS and pipette up and down several times.
Add Laminin-E8/PBS solution to one well of 6-well plates.
Incubate at 37°C for at least 30 min.
Aspirate the medium from the wells and rinse with PBS two times.
Add 500 μL Accutase and incubate at 37°C for 20–30 min.
Add 1 mL of Wash medium and gently pipette up and down to dislodge the cells from the well.
Transfer the cells to a 15-mL tube and add 5 mL of Wash medium.
Centrifuge at 1,300 rpm for 3 min.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet with 2 mL HBSS with 1% BSA buffer (1% BSA/HBSS) and Y-27632.
Incubate at 4°C for at least 30 min.
Centrifuge at 1,300 rpm for 3 min.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet with 1% BSA/HBSS with anti-TACSTD2, biotin-conjugated antibody, and anti-ENPEP, PE-conjugated antibody.
Incubate at 4°C for 30 min in the dark.
Resuspend with 1 mL of 1% BSA/HBSS.
Centrifuge at 1,300 rpm for 3 min.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend with 1% BSA/HBSS with anti-Streptavidin, APC-conjugated antibody.
Incubate at 4°C for 30 min.
Resuspend with 1 mL of 1% BSA/HBSS.
Centrifuge at 1,300 rpm for 3 min.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend with 300–500 μL of 1% BSA/HBSS.
Sort TACSTD2+ENPEP+ cells.
Seed TACSTD2+ENPEP+ cells at a density of 2 × 10^4 to 4 × 10^4 cells/cm² on Laminin-E8-coated dishes in ACE medium with 10 μM Y-27632 and 1% Penicillin-Streptomycin.
Replace the ACE medium every two days.
Passage cells every 3–6 days by dissociation with Accutase for 10–15 min.
Seed cells at a 1:3-1:4 split ratio after dissociation.
Add 10 μM Y-27632 for every passage.
Prepare Laminin-E8-coated wells beforehand.
Mix 1.5 μg of Laminin-E8 with 1 ml PBS and pipette up and down several times.
Incubate the Laminin-E8/PBS solution in one well of a 6-well dish at 37°C for at least 30 min in 5% O2.
Aspirate the medium from the wells and rinse with PBS two times in 21% O2.
Add 500 μl Accutase to the wells and incubate at 37°C for 10–15 min in 5% O2.
Add 1 mL of Wash medium and gently pipette up and down to dislodge the cells from the well in 21% O₂.
Transfer the cells to a 15-mL tube and add 5 mL of Wash medium in 21% O₂.
Centrifuge at 1,300 rpm for 3 min in 21% O₂.
Add ACE medium with Y-27632 for 24 hours.
Seed the cells at a density of 4 × 10⁴ cells/cm² on Laminin-E8-coated wells in 21% O₂.
Incubate the cells in 5% O₂, 5% CO₂.
Replace the medium every two days.
Passage the cells every 3–6 days by dissociation with Accutase for 10–15 minutes.
Seed the cells at a 1:3-1:4 split ratio.
Add 10 μM Y-27632 for every passage.
Add 1.5 μg (3 μL) of Laminin-E8 to 1 mL of PBS.
Pipette up and down several times to mix.
Add the Laminin-E8/PBS solution to one well of 6-well dishes.
Incubate at 37°C for at least 30 min.
Aspirate the medium from the wells.
Rinse with PBS two times.
Add 500 μL Accutase and incubate at 37°C for 20–30 min.
Add 1 mL of Wash medium and gently pipette up and down to dislodge the cells.
Transfer the cells to a 15-mL tube and add 5 mL of Wash medium.
Centrifuge at 1,300 rpm for 3 min.
Resuspend with ST medium.
Seed the cells at a density of 1 × 10^4 cells/cm^2 on the Laminin-E8-coated wells.
Replace the medium at day 3.
Observe the nSTs on day 6.
Add 500 μL Accutase.
Incubate at 37°C for 20–30 min.
Add 1 mL of Wash medium and gently pipette up and down to dislodge the cells from the well.
Transfer the cells to a 15-mL tube.
Add 5 mL of Wash medium.
Centrifuge at 1,300 rpm for 3 min.
Resuspend with EVT-1 medium.
Seed the cells at a density of 0.8 × 10^4 cells/cm² on Laminin-E8-coated wells.
Add 2% Geltrex to the medium.
Replace EVT-1 medium with EVT-2 medium on day 3.
Add 0.5% Geltrex to the medium.
Dissociate the cells into single cells with Accutase for 10–15 min on day 6.
Resuspend with EVT-3 medium.
Seed the cells on new Laminin-E8-coated wells at a 1:2–1:3 split ratio.
Add 0.5% Geltrex to the medium.
Analyze the cells on day 8.
Add 1.5 μg of Laminin-E8 to 1 mL of PBS.
Pipette up and down several times to mix.
Incubate the Laminin-E8/PBS solution in one well of a 6-well dish at 37°C for at least 30 min.
Manually separate human chorionic villi from the chorionic membrane and decidua.
Cut the chorionic villi into small pieces and transfer to a 50-mL tube.
Rinse the villous fragments with 40 mL of sterile PBS.
Centrifuge at 800 rpm (120 g) for 2 min.
Aspirate most of the supernatant.
Repeat the rinse procedure.
Shake the tube vigorously until the supernatant is clear.
Digest three times in a solution containing 0.25% Trypsin, 1 mg/mL collagenase IV, 200 U/mL DNase (Sigma-Aldrich), 25 mM HEPES, and DMEM/F-12 medium with agitation at 37°C.
Filter pooled cell suspensions through a 70-μm mesh filter to remove debris and syncytiotrophoblasts.
Add 30 mL of Wash medium and centrifuge at 1,300 rpm for 3 min.
Resuspend the pellet in 1% BSA/HBSS and incubate on ice for 30 min.
Centrifuge at 1,300 rpm for 3 min, aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend with 1% BSA/HBSS containing an Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-TACSTD2 antibody, a PE-conjugated anti-ENPEP antibody, and a biotin-conjugated anti-SIGLEC6 antibody.
Incubate at 4°C for 30 min.
Resuspend with 1 mL of 1% BSA/HBSS.
Centrifuge at 1,300 rpm for 3 min and aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend in 1% BSA/HBSS containing an anti-Streptavidin, APC-conjugated antibody.
Incubate at 4°C for 30 min.
Collect TACSTD2+ENPEP+SIGLEC6+ cells using a cell sorter.
Keep the collection medium cool (4°C) during cell sorting to maintain viability of the cells.
Centrifuge at 1,300 rpm for 3 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend with ACE medium supplemented with 1% Penicillin-Streptomycin.
Seed the cells at a density of 4 × 10^4 cells/cm^2 on Laminin-E8-coated wells.
Replace the medium every two days.
Passage the cells every 3–6 days by dissociation with Accutase for 10–15 min and seed at a 1:3–1:4 split ratio.
Add 10 μM Y-27632 with every passage.
